title: Add JSON output for `uv pip install` and `uv pip sync`
body:
## Summary

Add `--output-format json` to `uv pip install` and `uv pip sync` so callers can inspect package changes without parsing progress messages. It works for regular operations, `--dry-run`, and `--check`, writes JSON to stdout, and leaves diagnostics on stderr. Like `uv sync`, check mode emits the proposed changes even when it exits with code 1 because the environment is outdated.

Both commands use the experimental package-change schema shared with `uv sync`, including installs, removals, and reinstalls. The report includes whether the command was a dry run and returns an empty change list when no changes are made or planned.
